description: This Java class 'RetrieveConf' represents a specific type of MMS PDU (Protocol Data Unit) related to 'Retrieve Confirmation' messages in an MMS messaging system. It extends 'MultimediaMessagePdu' and provides constructors and getter/setter methods for various headers such as CC, Content-Type, From, message class, message ID, delivery report, retrieve status, retrieve text, and transaction ID. The class is part of an MMS library handling message protocol details.

classes.name: RetrieveConf
classes.description: Represents a 'Retrieve Confirmation' MMS PDU, used for confirming the receipt of message retrieval requests within the MMS protocol.
